name: sound-recreation-agent
description: AI agent for recreating keyboard sounds, powered by Vercel AI SDK and MCP

scripts.dev: AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY=$(op read 'op://Private/vercel ai api-gateway key/password' --account my.1password.com) TAVILY_API_KEY=$(op read 'op://Private/tavily api key free tier/credential' --account my.1password.com) tsx src/index.ts
scripts.dev:full: AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY=$(op read 'op://Private/vercel ai api-gateway key/password' --account my.1password.com) TAVILY_API_KEY=$(op read 'op://Private/tavily api key free tier/credential' --account my.1password.com) tsx src/index.ts -- --keyboards-mcp ../keyboards-mcp/dist/index.js --audio-mcp ../audio-analysis-mcp/.venv/bin/python
scripts.test:integration: AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY=$(op read 'op://Private/vercel ai api-gateway key/password' --account my.1password.com) npx tsx --test tests/integration/agent.test.ts
scripts.test:ci: npm run lint && npm run test
